回归本源：让去噪生成模型真正去噪

Back to Basics: Let Denoising Generative Models Denoise

Tianhong Li · 何恺明（Kaiming He） · MIT

扩散模型通常让网络预测噪声或加噪量；这篇论文让网络直接预测干净图像，并用大图块把像素 Transformer 做到有竞争力的 FID。本页逐段对照原文，并把每个公式、图、表和算法讲清楚。

读之前，先把这几个量分清

这一段是本站讲解，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你在读到公式 (1)–(8) 时，知道每个符号在做什么。

  1. 时间方向：t=0t=0t=0 是纯噪声，t=1t=1t=1 是干净图像。采样从 0 积到 1。很多扩散论文方向相反，读的时候先核对。
  2. 三个量：x\bm{x}x 干净图像、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 噪声、v=x−ϵ\bm{v}=\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}v=x−ϵ 速度。网络“预测谁”指最后一层直接输出谁；“损失在谁的空间”是另一件事（表 1）。
  3. token 与 patch 维度：JiT 把图像切成 p×pp\times pp×p 图块，每块展平成 p×p×3p\times p\times3p×p×3 维 token。分辨率翻倍时 ppp 也翻倍，token 数保持 256，但每个 token 变宽。
  4. 权重的方向：x\bm{x}x-预测配 v\bm{v}v-损失，等价于 x\bm{x}x-MSE 乘 1/(1−t)21/(1-t)^21/(1−t)2；权重在 t→1t\to1t→1（干净端）变大，不是在高噪声端变大。
推导：x\bm{x}x-预测 + v\bm{v}v-损失到底加权在哪一端
本站推导（代数恒等式）
∥vθ(zt,t)−v∥2=1(1−t)2∥xθ(zt,t)−x∥2\left\|\bm{v}_\theta(\bm{z}_t,t)-\bm{v}\right\|^2=\frac{1}{(1-t)^2}\left\|\bm{x}_\theta(\bm{z}_t,t)-\bm{x}\right\|^2∥vθ​(zt​,t)−v∥2=(1−t)21​∥xθ​(zt​,t)−x∥2
  1. 由定义 v=(x−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}=(\bm{x}-\bm{z}_t)/(1-t)v=(x−zt​)/(1−t)，以及网络换算出的 vθ=(xθ−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}_\theta=(\bm{x}_\theta-\bm{z}_t)/(1-t)vθ​=(xθ​−zt​)/(1−t)。
  2. 两者相减：vθ−v=(xθ−x)/(1−t)\bm{v}_\theta-\bm{v}=(\bm{x}_\theta-\bm{x})/(1-t)vθ​−v=(xθ​−x)/(1−t)。
  3. 平方后：∥vθ−v∥2=1(1−t)2∥xθ−x∥2\|\bm{v}_\theta-\bm{v}\|^2=\frac{1}{(1-t)^2}\|\bm{x}_\theta-\bm{x}\|^2∥vθ​−v∥2=(1−t)21​∥xθ​−x∥2。
  4. 看权重的两端：t→0t\to0t→0（纯噪声）时权重是 1；t→1t\to1t→1（干净图像）时未截断的权重发散。实际实现把分母截断到 0.05，权重上限是 1/0.052=4001/0.05^2=4001/0.052=400，所以推导里的发散不应读成训练中真的出现无限权重。
  5. 所以“x\bm{x}x-预测 + v\bm{v}v-损失”不是忽略干净端，而是把训练重点压到干净端附近。这与“强调高噪声端”的常见直觉相反，是理解第 4.2 节的关键。

这是代数恒等式，不是“x\bm{x}x-预测在所有任务上都更好”的证明；它只说明这一组合在优化时把权重放在哪里。

token 数、patch 维度与隐藏维度（表 5/6 的读法）
设置token 数每个 token 维度隐藏维度
256×256，JiT/1616×1616×16×3 = 768768
512×512，JiT/3216×1632×32×3 = 3072768
1024×1024，JiT/6416×1664×64×3 = 12288768

256 与 512/1024 的 token 数都是 256；变大的是每个 token 的维度。JiT-B 的隐藏维度 768 与 256 分辨率、p=16p=16p=16 的 patch 维度恰好相等，所以表 5 第一行的“每图块维度”和“隐藏维度”相同；512 与 1024 的 patch 维度才远大于隐藏维度。

术语速查（本站整理）
流形（manifold）
高维空间里一张低维的“薄面”。干净图像集中在这张面上；噪声与速度不在面上。这是本文用来解释“预测干净图像更容易”的假设，不是已证明的定理。
x\bm{x}x / ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ / v\bm{v}v
x\bm{x}x 是干净图像，ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 是标准高斯噪声，v=x−ϵ\bm{v}=\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}v=x−ϵ 是从噪声指向图像的流速度。三者都是与图像同形状的张量。
x\bm{x}x-预测 / ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测 / v\bm{v}v-预测
指网络最后一层直接吐出的量，而不是损失定义在哪个空间。表 1 把“输出空间”和“损失空间”分开列。
flow matching
训练网络回归一个速度场，再用 ODE 积分从噪声走到数据。本文的时间方向是 t=0t=0t=0 噪声、t=1t=1t=1 数据。
patch / token
图像切成不重叠的 p×pp\times pp×p 小块，每块展平成一个 token。JiT/16 在 256 分辨率下是 16×16=25616\times16=25616×16=256 个 token，每个 token 16×16×3=76816\times16\times3=76816×16×3=768 维。
隐藏维度
Transformer 内部表示的宽度。JiT-B 是 768，与 256 分辨率、p=16p=16p=16 的 patch 维度恰好相等。
瓶颈（bottleneck）
在 patch 嵌入与 Transformer 之间插入低秩线性层，把每个 token 先压到 d′d'd′ 维再升回隐藏维度。图 4 显示 d′=64d'=64d′=64 最好，不是越小或越大越好。
CFG / CFG interval
classifier-free guidance 用有条件与无条件预测的差放大条件；CFG interval 只在部分时间步施加引导。图 6 比较两者的 FID 曲线。
EMA
训练时维护参数的指数滑动平均副本，推理时使用。本文为不同模型分别搜索衰减率。
早停
监控 FID，开始变差就停止。JiT-G 规模约在 320 轮早停；表 6 的 600 列是训练预算标签，不是实际轮数。
FID / IS / Precision / Recall
FID 越低越好，衡量分布距离；IS 越高通常表示样本可辨认且多样；Precision/Recall 分开衡量保真与覆盖。
预条件器（pre-conditioner）
把网络输出包成 xθ=cskipzt+coutnetθ\bm{x}_\theta=c_{\text{skip}}\bm{z}_t+c_{\text{out}}\text{net}_\thetaxθ​=cskip​zt​+cout​netθ​ 的写法。只有 cskip=0,cout=1c_{\text{skip}}=0,c_{\text{out}}=1cskip​=0,cout​=1 时，网络输出本身才是 x\bm{x}x-预测。

摘要

English original
Abstract

如今的去噪扩散模型并不在经典意义上“去噪”，即它们并不直接预测干净图像。相反，神经网络预测的是噪声或某种加噪后的量。本文认为，预测干净数据与预测加噪量在本质上是不同的。依据流形假设，自然数据应当位于一个低维流形上，而加噪量不是。基于这一假设，我们主张采用直接预测干净数据的模型；这使得表面上看容量不足的网络也能在极高维空间中有效工作。我们表明，仅作用于像素、使用大图块的简单 Transformer 就可以是强生成模型：不用 tokenizer、不做预训练、不加额外损失。我们的方法在概念上不过是“Just image Transformers”，即我们所称的 JiT。我们在 ImageNet 上以 256 和 512 的分辨率、16 和 32 的大图块尺寸报告了有竞争力的结果；在同样的设置下，预测高维加噪量可能灾难性失败。通过让网络回到流形这一根本，我们的研究回到根本，追求一种在原始自然数据上做 Transformer 扩散的自包含范式。

English original
Today’s denoising diffusion models do not “denoise” in the classical sense, *i.e* . , they do not directly predict clean images. Rather, the neural networks predict noise or a noised quantity. In this paper, we suggest that predicting clean data and predicting noised quantities are fundamentally different. According to the manifold assumption, natural data should lie on a low-dimensional manifold, whereas noised quantities do not. With this assumption, we advocate for models that directly predict clean data, which allows apparently under-capacity networks to operate effectively in very high-dimensional spaces. We show that simple, large-patch Transformers on pixels can be strong generative models: using no tokenizer, no pre-training, and no extra loss. Our approach is conceptually nothing more than “ Just image Transformers ”, or JiT , as we call it. We report competitive results using JiT with large patch sizes of 16 and 32 on ImageNet at resolutions of 256 and 512, where predicting high-dimensional noised quantities can fail catastrophically. With our networks mapping back to the basics of the manifold, our research goes back to basics and pursues a self-contained paradigm for Transformer-based diffusion on raw natural data.

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

扩散生成模型最初被提出时[ [57] , [59] , [23] ]，其核心思想本应是去噪，即从受损版本预测干净图像。然而，扩散模型演化过程中的两个重要里程碑偏离了直接预测干净图像这一目标。首先，直接预测噪声本身（即“ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测”）[23]在生成质量上带来了关键差异，并在很大程度上让这类模型流行起来。后来，扩散模型通过预测流速度（即“v\bm{v}v-预测”[52]，一个结合了干净数据与噪声的量）与基于流的方法[ [37] , [38] , [1] ]建立了联系。今天，实践中使用的扩散模型通常预测噪声或某种加噪量（例如速度）。

English original
When diffusion generative models were first developed [ [57] , [59] , [23] ] , the core idea was supposed to be denoising , *i.e* . , predicting a clean image from its corrupted version. However, two significant milestones in the evolution of diffusion models turned out to deviate from the goal of directly predicting clean images. First, predicting the noise itself (known as “ ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -prediction”) [23] made a pivotal difference in generation quality and largely popularized these models. Later, diffusion models were connected to flow-based methods [ [37] , [38] , [1] ] through predicting the flow velocity (“ v\bm{v}v -prediction ” [52] ), a quantity that combines clean data and noise. Today, diffusion models in practice commonly predict noise or a noised quantity ( *e.g* . , velocity).

大量研究[ [52] , [29] , [25] , [15] ]已经表明，预测干净图像（“x\bm{x}x-预测”[52]）与 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测、v\bm{v}v-预测密切相关，前提是相应地重新表述预测损失的加权方式（详见第 3 节）。由于存在这种关系，人们较少关注网络究竟应当直接预测什么，而是隐含地假定网络有能力完成被指派的任务。

English original
Extensive studies [ [52] , [29] , [25] , [15] ] have shown that predicting the clean image (“ x\bm{x}x -prediction ” [52] ) is closely related to ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ - and v\bm{v}v -prediction, provided that the weighting of the prediction loss is reformulated accordingly (detailed in Sec. 3 ). Owing to this relation, less attention has been paid to what the network should directly predict, implicitly assuming that the network is capable of performing the assigned task.

然而，干净图像与加噪量（包括噪声本身）的角色并不对等。在机器学习中，长期存在这样一个假设[ [4] , [3] ]：“（高维）数据（大致）位于一个低维流形上”（[ [4] , p.6]）。在这一流形假设下，干净数据可以被建模为位于低维流形上，而加噪量本质上分布在整个高维空间中[69]（见图 1）。预测干净数据与预测噪声或加噪量有根本区别。

English original
However, the roles of clean images and a noised quantity (including the noise itself) are not equal. In machine learning, it has long been hypothesized [ [4] , [3] ] that “(high-dimensional) data lie (roughly) on a low-dimensional manifold” ( [ [4] , p.6] ). Under this manifold assumption, while clean data can be modeled as lying on a low-dimensional manifold, a noised quantity is inherently distributed across the full high-dimensional space [69] (see Fig. 1 ). Predicting clean data is fundamentally different from predicting noise or a noised quantity.
本站讲解：先弄懂“低维流形”到底在说什么
流形在这里不是抽象拓扑概念，而是一句很具体的话：高维空间里，真实数据并不铺满所有方向，而是集中在一张很薄的面上。一张 256×256 的彩色图有约 19 万个数值，理论上能取遍整个空间，但真实照片只占其中极小一片——改变光照、姿态、物体身份会移动位置，而随机改像素不会落回照片集合。作者要对比的正是这一点：干净图像待在这张薄片上，加噪后的量（噪声本身、以及数据与噪声混合的速度）被推到薄片之外，铺满整个空间。这是作者引用的假设[4,3]，用来解释现象，不是被证明的定理；加噪量铺满高维空间这一说法来自[69]与图 1。

设想这样一个情形：一个低维流形嵌入在高维观测空间之中。在这个高维空间里预测噪声需要高容量：网络必须保留关于噪声的全部信息。相反，容量有限的网络仍然可以预测干净数据，因为它只需要保留低维信息，同时把噪声滤除。

English original
Consider a scenario where a low-dimensional manifold is embedded in a high-dimensional observation space. Predicting noise in this high-dimensional space requires high capacity : the network needs to preserve all information about the noise. In contrast, a limited-capacity network can still predict the clean data, as it only needs to retain the low-dimensional information while filtering out the noise.

当使用低维空间（例如图像潜变量[49]）时，预测噪声的难度得到缓解，但这一难度同时是被隐藏、而非被解决。一旦涉及像素或其他高维空间，现有扩散模型仍可能难以应对维数灾难[4]。对预训练潜空间的重度依赖使扩散模型无法自包含。

English original
When a low-dimensional space ( *e.g* . , image latent [49] ) is used, the difficulty of predicting noise is alleviated, yet at the same time is hidden rather than solved. When it comes to pixel or other high-dimensional spaces, existing diffusion models can still struggle to address the curse of dimensionality [4] . The heavy reliance on a pre-trained latent space prevents diffusion models from being self-contained.

为了追求自包含这一原则，像素空间中的扩散建模受到了高度重视[ [7] , [25] , [26] , [6] , [70] ]。总体而言，这些方法以显式或隐式的方式避开网络中的信息瓶颈，例如使用密集卷积或更小的图块、增加通道数、或加入长跳跃连接。我们认为，这些设计可能源自预测高维加噪量的需求。

English original
In pursuit of a self-contained principle, there has been strong focus on advancing diffusion modeling in the pixel space [ [7] , [25] , [26] , [6] , [70] ] . In general, these methods explicitly or implicitly avoid the information bottleneck in the networks, *e.g* . , by using dense convolutions or smaller patches, increasing channels, or adding long skip connections. We suggest that these designs may stem from the demand to predict high-dimensional noised quantities.

本文回到第一性原理，让神经网络直接预测干净图像。由此我们表明，一个朴素的 Vision Transformer（ViT）[13]，在由原始像素组成的大图块上运行，就可以有效地进行扩散建模。我们的方法自包含，不依赖任何预训练或辅助损失——没有潜变量 tokenizer[49]，没有对抗损失[ [16] , [49] ]，没有感知损失[ [77] , [49] ]（因而没有预训练分类器[56]），也没有表征对齐[74]（因而没有自监督预训练[45]）。在概念上，我们的模型不过就是把“Just image Transformers”（我们称之为 JiT）用于扩散。

English original
In this paper, we return to first principles and let the neural network directly predict the clean image. By doing so, we show that a plain Vision Transformer (ViT) [13] , operating on large image patches consisting of raw pixels, can be effective for diffusion modeling. Our approach is self-contained and does not rely on any pre-training or auxiliary loss — no latent tokenizer [49] , no adversarial loss [ [16] , [49] ] , no perceptual loss [ [77] , [49] ] (thus no pre-trained classifier [56] ), and no representation alignment [74] (thus no self-supervised pre-training [45] ) . Conceptually, our model is nothing more than “Just image Transformers”, or JiT , as we call it, applied to diffusion.
本站讲解：“自包含”具体指省掉了什么
作者列的自包含清单是可核对的四件事：没有潜变量 tokenizer（不需要先训练一个把图像压成 latent 的自编码器）、没有对抗损失、没有感知损失（因此也不需要预训练的分类器当裁判）、没有表征对齐（因此也不需要自监督预训练的特征）。合起来的意思是：整条 pipeline 里没有第二个需要单独预训练的大组件，训练一个网络就从像素到像素。作者的主张是这种极简结构在大图块、高维 token 下仍然可用，而不是“越简单效果一定越好”。

我们在 ImageNet 数据集[11]上进行实验，分辨率分别为 256 和 512，使用图块尺寸分别为 16 和 32 的 JiT 模型。尽管图块维度非常高（数百或数千维），我们使用 x\bm{x}x-预测的模型仍能轻松取得强结果，而 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测与 v\bm{v}v-预测在此情形下灾难性失败。进一步的分析表明，网络宽度并不需要匹配或超过图块维度；事实上，出乎意料的是，瓶颈设计甚至可能有益，这与经典流形学习中的观察相呼应。

English original
We conduct experiments on the ImageNet dataset [11] at resolutions of 256 and 512, using JiT models with patch sizes 16 and 32 respectively. Even though the patches are very high-dimensional (hundreds or thousands), our models using x\bm{x}x -prediction can easily produce strong results, where ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ - and v\bm{v}v -prediction fail catastrophically. Further analysis shows that it is unnecessary for the network width to match or exceed the patch dimension; in fact, and surprisingly, a bottleneck design can even be beneficial, echoing observations from classical manifold learning.

我们的工作是在原生数据上迈向自包含的“Diffusion + Transformer”理念[46]的一步。除计算机视觉之外，这一理念在涉及自然数据的其他领域（例如蛋白质、分子或天气）中也极具吸引力，因为这些领域中 tokenizer 难以设计。通过尽量减少领域特定的设计，我们希望源自计算机视觉的通用“Diffusion + Transformer”范式能找到更广泛的应用。

English original
Our effort marks a step toward a self-contained “Diffusion + Transformer” philosophy [46] on native data. Beyond computer vision, this philosophy is highly desirable in other domains involving natural data ( *e.g* . , proteins, molecules, or weather), where a tokenizer can be difficult to design. By minimizing domain-specific designs, we hope that the general “Diffusion + Transformer” paradigm originated from computer vision will find broader applicability.

2 相关工作

English original
2 Related Work

扩散模型及其预测。

English original
Diffusion Models and Their Predictions.

扩散模型的开创性工作[57]提出学习一个逆向随机过程，其中网络预测正态分布的参数（例如均值与标准差）。在其提出五年之后，这一方法被 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models（DDPM）[23]重新激活并推广：其中一项关键发现是让噪声成为预测目标（即 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测）。

English original
The pioneering work on diffusion models [57] proposed to learn a reversed stochastic process, in which the network predicts the parameters of a normal distribution ( *e.g* . , mean and standard deviation). Five years after its introduction, this method was revitalized and popularized by Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) [23] : a pivotal discovery was to make noise the prediction target ( *i.e* . , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -prediction).

随后，[52]（最初是在模型蒸馏的背景下）研究了不同预测目标之间的关系，并在其中引入了 v\bm{v}v-预测这一概念。他们的工作关注重参数化所带来的加权效应。

English original
The relationships among different prediction targets were then investigated in [52] (originally in the context of model distillation), where the notion of v\bm{v}v -prediction was also introduced. Their work focused on the weighting effects introduced by reparameterization.

与此同时，EDM[29]围绕去噪器函数（denoiser）重新表述了扩散问题，这是扩散模型演化中的一个重要里程碑。然而，EDM 采用了预条件化的表述，网络的直接输出并不是去噪后的图像。这种表述在低维情形下更可取，但它本质上仍要求网络输出一个混合了数据与噪声的量（更多比较见附录）。

English original
Meanwhile, EDM [29] reformulated the diffusion problem around a denoiser function , which constitutes a major milestone in the evolution of diffusion models. However, EDM adopted a pre-conditioned formulation, where the direct output of the network is not the denoised image. While this formulation is preferable in low-dimensional scenarios, it still inherently requires the network to output a quantity that mixes data and noise (more comparisons in appendix).

Flow Matching 模型[ [37] , [38] , [1] ]可以解释为扩散建模范式内的一种 v\bm{v}v-预测[52]形式。与纯噪声不同，v\bm{v}v 是数据与噪声的组合。基于流的模型与先前扩散模型之间的联系已经建立[15]。今天，扩散模型及其基于流的对应物常常在统一框架下被研究。

English original
Flow Matching models [ [37] , [38] , [1] ] can be interpreted as a form of v\bm{v}v -prediction [52] within the diffusion modeling framework. Unlike pure noise, v\bm{v}v is a combination of data and noise. The connections between flow-based models and previous diffusion models have been established [15] . Today, diffusion models and their flow-based counterparts are often studied under a unified framework.

去噪模型。

English original
Denoising Models.

在过去几十年中，去噪这一概念与表征学习紧密相关。以 BM3D[9]及其他方法[ [47] , [14] , [79] ]为代表的经典方法，利用稀疏性与低维性假设来执行图像去噪。

English original
Over the past decades, the concept of denoising has been closely related to representation learning. Classical methods, exemplified by BM3D [9] and others [ [47] , [14] , [79] ] , leveraged the assumptions of sparsity and low dimensionality to perform image denoising.

去噪自编码器（DAE）[ [68] , [69] ]是作为一种无监督表征学习方法发展起来的，以去噪作为其训练目标。它们借助流形假设[4]（图 1）来学习有意义的、能近似低维数据流形的表征。DAE 可以被视为 Denoising Score Matching[67]的一种形式，而后者又与基于分数的现代扩散模型[ [59] , [60] ]密切相关。然而，尽管 DAE 为进行流形学习而预测干净数据是自然的，在 score matching 中，预测 score 函数实际上等同于预测噪声（相差一个缩放因子），即 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测。

English original
Denoising Autoencoders (DAEs) [ [68] , [69] ] were developed as an unsupervised representation learning method, using denoising as their training objective. They leveraged the manifold assumption [4] ( Fig. 1 ) to learn meaningful representations that approximate the low-dimensional data manifold. DAEs can be viewed as a form of Denoising Score Matching [67] , which in turn is closely related to modern score-based diffusion models [ [59] , [60] ] . Nevertheless, while it is natural for DAEs to predict clean data for manifold learning, in score matching, predicting the score function effectively amounts to predicting the noise (up to a scaling factor), *i.e* . , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -prediction.

流形学习。

English original
Manifold Learning.

流形学习一直是一个经典领域[ [51] , [63] ]，专注于从观测数据中学习低维、非线性的表征。总体而言，流形学习方法利用瓶颈结构[ [64] , [48] , [41] , [2] ]，只鼓励有用的信息通过。若干研究探讨了流形学习与生成模型之间的联系[ [39] , [27] , [8] ]。Latent Diffusion Models（LDM）[49]可以被视为在第一阶段通过自编码器进行流形学习，在第二阶段再进行扩散。

English original
Manifold learning has been a classical field [ [51] , [63] ] focused on learning low-dimensional, nonlinear representations from observed data. In general, manifold learning methods leverage bottleneck structures [ [64] , [48] , [41] , [2] ] that encourage only useful information to pass through. Several studies have explored the connections between manifold learning and generative models [ [39] , [27] , [8] ] . Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) [49] can be viewed as manifold learning in the first stage via an autoencoder, followed by diffusion in the second stage.

像素空间扩散。

English original
Pixel-space Diffusion.

尽管潜变量扩散[49]在今天已成为该领域的默认选择，扩散模型的发展最初却始于像素空间的表述[ [59] , [23] , [44] , [12] ]。早期像素空间扩散模型通常基于密集卷积网络，最常见的是 U-Net[50]。这类模型常常使用过完备的通道表示（例如在第一层把 H×W×3H{\times}W{\times}3H×W×3 变为 H×W×128H{\times}W{\times}128H×W×128），并配有长程跳跃连接。虽然这些模型对 ϵ\epsilonϵ-预测与 vvv-预测效果良好，但其密集卷积结构通常计算开销很大。把这类卷积模型应用到高分辨率图像并不会导致灾难性退化，因此该方向的研究通常聚焦于噪声调度和/或加权方案[ [7] , [25] , [26] , [30] ]，以进一步提升生成质量。

English original
While latent diffusion [49] has become the default choice in the field today, the development of diffusion models originally began with pixel-space formulations [ [59] , [23] , [44] , [12] ] . Early pixel-space diffusion models were typically based on dense convolutional networks, most often a U-Net [50] . These models often use over-complete channel representations ( *e.g* . , transforming H×W×3H{\times}W{\times}3H×W×3 into H×W×128H{\times}W{\times}128H×W×128 in the first layer), accompanied by long-range skip connections. While these models work well for ϵ\epsilonϵ - and vvv -prediction, their dense convolutional structures are typically computationally expensive. Applying these convolutional models to high-resolution images does not lead to catastrophic degradation, and as such, research in this direction has commonly focused on noise schedules and/or weighting schemes [ [7] , [25] , [26] , [30] ] to further improve generation quality.

相比之下，把 Vision Transformer（ViT）[13]直接用于像素是一项更具挑战性的任务。标准 ViT 架构采用激进的图块尺寸（例如 16 ×\times× 16 像素），由此得到高维的 token 空间，其维度可与 Transformer 的隐藏维度相当甚至更大。SiD2[26]与 PixelFlow[6]采用从小图块开始的分层设计；然而，这些模型是“FLOP-heavy”的[26]，并且丧失了标准 Transformer 固有的通用性与简洁性。PixNerd[70]采用一个 NeRF 头[43]，整合来自 Transformer 输出、噪声输入与空间坐标的信息，训练时还借助表征对齐[74]来辅助。

English original
In contrast, applying a Vision Transformer (ViT) [13] directly to pixels presents a more challenging task. Standard ViT architectures adopt an aggressive patch size ( *e.g* . , 16 ×\times× 16 pixels), resulting in a high-dimensional token space that can be comparable to, or larger than, the Transformer’s hidden dimension. SiD2 [26] and PixelFlow [6] adopt hierarchical designs that start from smaller patches; however, these models are “FLOP-heavy” [26] and lose the inherent generality and simplicity of standard Transformers. PixNerd [70] adopts a NeRF head [43] that integrates information from the Transformer output, noisy input, and spatial coordinates, with training further assisted by representation alignment [74] .

即便采用这些专用设计，这些工作中的架构通常也从“L”（Large）或“XL”规模起步。事实上，一项最新工作[73]表明，对于高维情形，较大的隐藏维度似乎是必要的。

English original
Even with these special-purpose designs, the architectures in these works typically start from the “L” (Large) or “XL” size. In fact, a latest work [73] suggests that a large hidden size appears necessary for high dimensionality.

高维扩散。

English original
High-dimensional Diffusion.

在使用 ViT 式架构时，现代扩散模型仍受高维输入空间的挑战，无论输入是像素还是潜变量。文献[ [8] , [73] , [55] ]中反复报告，无论使用像素还是潜变量，当每个 token 的维度增加时，ViT 式扩散模型都会迅速且灾难性地退化。

English original
When using ViT-style architectures, modern diffusion models are still challenged by high-dimensional input spaces, whether in pixels or latents. In the literature [ [8] , [73] , [55] ] , it has been repeatedly reported that ViT-style diffusion models degrade rapidly and catastrophically when the per-token dimensionality increases, regardless of the use of pixels or latents.

与我们的工作同时，一系列研究[ [78] , [34] , [55] ]求助于自监督预训练来解决高维扩散问题。与这些努力不同，我们表明高维扩散无需任何预训练即可实现，而且只用 Transformer。

English original
Concurrently with our work, a line of research [ [78] , [34] , [55] ] resorts to self-supervised pre-training to address high-dimensional diffusion. In contrast to these efforts, we show that high-dimensional diffusion is achievable without any pre-training, and using just Transformers.

x\bm{x}x-预测。

English original
x\bm{x}x -prediction.

x\bm{x}x-预测的表述是自然的，也并不新颖；它至少可以追溯到最初的 DDPM[23]（见其代码[24]）。然而，DDPM 观察到 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-预测显著更好，这一点后来成为首选方案。在后续工作中（例如[26]），尽管分析有时更倾向于在 x\bm{x}x-空间中进行，实际的预测却常常在其他空间完成，很可能是出于历史遗留原因。

English original
The formulation of x\bm{x}x -prediction is natural and not new; it can be traced back at least to the original DDPM [23] (see their code [24] ). However, DDPM observed that ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -prediction was substantially better, which later became the go-to solution. In later works ( *e.g* . , [26] ), although the analysis was sometimes preferably conducted in the x\bm{x}x -space, the actual prediction was often made in other spaces, likely for legacy reasons.

至于扩散所处理的图像复原应用[ [10] , [72] , [42] ]，让网络预测干净数据是自然的，因为这正是图像复原的最终目标。与我们的工作同时，[18]也主张使用 x\bm{x}x-预测，用于以先前帧为条件的生成式世界模型。

English original
When it comes to the image restoration application addressed by diffusion [ [10] , [72] , [42] ] , it is natural for the network to predict the clean data, as this is the ultimate goal of image restoration. Concurrent with our work, [18] also advocates the use of x\bm{x}x -prediction, for generative world models that are conditional on previous frames.

我们的工作并非要重新发明这一基本概念；相反，我们想提请注意一个在具有潜在低维流形的高维数据背景下被大量忽视、却十分关键的问题。

English original
Our work does not aim to reinvent this fundamental concept; rather, we aim to draw attention to a largely overlooked yet critical issue in the context of high-dimensional data with underlying low-dimensional manifolds.

3 扩散模型的预测输出

English original
3 On Prediction Outputs of Diffusion Models

扩散模型可以在 x\bm{x}x、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 或 v\bm{v}v 空间中表述。空间的选择不仅决定了损失定义在哪里，也决定了网络预测什么。重要的是，损失空间与网络输出空间不必相同。这一选择可能带来关键差异。

English original
Diffusion models can be formulated in the space of x\bm{x}x , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ , or v\bm{v}v . The choice of the space determines not only where the loss is defined, but also what the network predicts. Importantly, the loss space and the network output space need not be the same . This choice can make critical differences.
本站讲解：输出空间和损失空间是两件独立的事
读这一节要先分开两个问题：(1) 误差在哪个空间里量——这就是损失空间；(2) 网络最后一层直接吐出哪个量——这就是输出空间。表 1 的 3×3 就是这两件事的笛卡尔积：三行是三种损失（x、ε、v），三列是三种网络输出。行列不相同时，做法是先把网络输出用代数关系换算到损失所在的空间，再算误差；代入之后，效果等于给原来的损失乘上一个只依赖 t 的权重。所以更准确的说法是：在固定网络直接输出（参数化）的前提下，改变损失空间等价于给原损失乘一个只依赖 ttt 的时间权重。若连网络直接输出也换掉，有限网络要拟合的函数本身就变了，不能只归结为权重。

3.1 背景：扩散与流

English original
3.1 Background: Diffusion and Flows

扩散模型可以从 ODE 的角度来表述[ [5] , [60] , [37] , [58] ]。我们以基于流的范式[ [37] , [38] , [1] ]（即 v\bm{v}v 空间）作为更简单的起点开始表述，然后再讨论其他空间。

English original
Diffusion models can be formulated from the perspective of ODEs [ [5] , [60] , [37] , [58] ] . We begin our formulation with the flow-based paradigm [ [37] , [38] , [1] ] , *i.e* . , in the v\bm{v}v -space, as a simpler starting point, and then discuss other spaces.

3.2 预测空间与损失空间

English original
3.2 Prediction Space and Loss Space

预测空间。

English original
Prediction Space.

网络的直接输出可以定义在任意空间中：v\bm{v}v、x\bm{x}x 或 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ。下面讨论由此产生的变换。注意，在本文语境下，只有当网络 netθ\text{{net}}_{\theta}netθ​ 的直接输出严格为 x\bm{x}x、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ、v\bm{v}v 时，我们才分别称其为“x\bm{x}x、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ、v\bm{v}v-预测”。

English original
The network’s direct output can be defined in any space: v\bm{v}v , x\bm{x}x , or ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ . Next, we discuss the resulting transformation. Note that in the context of this paper, we refer to it as “ x\bm{x}x , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ , v\bm{v}v - prediction ”, only when the network netθ\text{{net}}_{\theta}netθ​ ’s direct output is strictly x\bm{x}x , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ , v\bm{v}v , respectively.

给定三个未知量（x\bm{x}x、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ、v\bm{v}v）与一个网络输出，我们需要两个额外的约束才能确定全部三个未知量。这两个约束由式 1与式 2给出。例如，当我们令网络的直接输出 netθ\text{{net}}_{\theta}netθ​ 为 x\bm{x}x 时，我们求解如下方程组：

English original
Given three unknowns ( x\bm{x}x , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ , v\bm{v}v ) and one network output, we require two additional constraints to determine all three unknowns. The two constraints are given by Eq. 1 and ( 2 ). For example , when we let the direct network output netθ\text{{net}}_{\theta}netθ​ be x\bm{x}x , we solve the following set of equations:

这里，记号 xθ\bm{x}_{\theta}xθ​、ϵθ\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}ϵθ​、vθ\bm{v}_{\theta}vθ​ 表明它们都是依赖于 θ\thetaθ 的预测。解这个方程组得到：ϵθ=(zt−txθ)/(1−t)\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}=(\bm{z}_{t}-t\bm{x}_{\theta})/(1-t)ϵθ​=(zt​−txθ​)/(1−t) 与 vθ=(xθ−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)vθ​=(xθ​−zt​)/(1−t)，也就是说，ϵθ\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}ϵθ​ 与 vθ\bm{v}_{\theta}vθ​ 都可以由 zt\bm{z}_{t}zt​ 与网络输出 xθ\bm{x}_{\theta}xθ​ 算出。这些结果汇总在表 1的 (a) 列中。

Solving this equation set gives: ϵθ=(zt−txθ)/(1−t)\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}=(\bm{z}_{t}-t\bm{x}_{\theta})/(1-t)ϵθ​=(zt​−txθ​)/(1−t) and vθ=(xθ−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)vθ​=(xθ​−zt​)/(1−t) , that is, both ϵθ\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}ϵθ​ and vθ\bm{v}_{\theta}vθ​ can be computed from zt\bm{z}_{t}zt​ and the network xθ\bm{x}_{\theta}xθ​ . Similarly, when we let the direct network output netθ\text{{net}}_{\theta}netθ​ be ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ or v\bm{v}v , we obtain the other sets of equations (by replacing the first one in Eq. 5 ). The transformations are summarized in Tab. 1 in the columns of (b) , (c) for ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -, v\bm{v}v -prediction. This shows that when one quantity in {x,ϵ,v}\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}{x,ϵ,v} is predicted, the other two can be inferred. The derivations in many prior works ( *e.g* . , [ [52] , [15] ] ) are special cases covered in Tab. 1 .

损失空间。

English original
Loss Space.

虽然损失常常在某一个参考空间中定义（例如式 3中的 v\bm{v}v-损失），但从概念上讲，它可以定义在任意空间。已有研究表明[ [52] , [15] ]，在从一个预测空间到另一个的重参数化下，损失实际上被重新加权。

English original
While the loss is often defined in one reference space ( *e.g* . , v\bm{v}v -loss in Eq. 3 ), conceptually, one can define it in any space. It has been shown [ [52] , [15] ] that with a given reparameterization from one prediction space to another, the loss is effectively reweighted.

例如，考虑表 1(3)(a) 中 x\bm{x}x-预测与 v\bm{v}v-损失的组合。我们以 vθ=(xθ−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)vθ​=(xθ​−zt​)/(1−t) 作为预测，以 v=(x−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}=(\bm{x}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)v=(x−zt​)/(1−t) 作为目标。式 3中的 v\bm{v}v-损失变为：L=E∥vθ(zt,t)−v∥2=E1(1−t)2∥xθ(zt,t)−x∥2,\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2}=\mathbb{E}\frac{1}{(1-t)^{2}}\|\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{x}\|^{2},L=E∥vθ​(zt​,t)−v∥2=E(1−t)21​∥xθ​(zt​,t)−x∥2, 这是 x\bm{x}x-损失的一种重新加权形式。对表 1中列出的任意预测空间与任意损失空间，都可以做类似的变换。

English original
For example , consider the combination of x\bm{x}x -prediction and v\bm{v}v -loss in Tab. 1 (3)(a) . We have vθ=(xθ−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)vθ​=(xθ​−zt​)/(1−t) as the prediction and v=(x−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}=(\bm{x}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)v=(x−zt​)/(1−t) as the target. The v\bm{v}v -loss in Eq. 3 becomes: L=E∥vθ(zt,t)−v∥2=E1(1−t)2∥xθ(zt,t)−x∥2,\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2}=\mathbb{E}\frac{1}{(1-t)^{2}}\|\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{x}\|^{2},L=E∥vθ​(zt​,t)−v∥2=E(1−t)21​∥xθ​(zt​,t)−x∥2, which is a reweighted form of the x\bm{x}x -loss. A transformation like this one can be done for any prediction space and any loss space listed in Tab. 1 .
本站讲解：时间往哪边走，权重压在哪一端
本文用线性调度 a_t=t、b_t=1-t，因此 t=0 是纯噪声，t=1 是干净数据，采样是从 t=0 解 ODE 走到 t=1。x-预测配 v-损失时，权重是 1/(1-t)²：t→1（靠近干净端）时权重发散，t→0（纯噪声端）时权重趋于 1。也就是说这个组合把学习压力集中在干净端附近的小噪声区间。把方向记反会得到完全相反的结论——这里被强调的不是高噪声端。作为对照，从表 1 同样可以读出：ε-预测配 x-损失时权重是 (1-t)²/t²，反而在 t→0 端放大。这个权重在 t 两端的极限差别极大，正是下一段说九种组合不能互相替代的算术原因。

综合起来，考虑在 {x,ϵ,v}\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}{x,ϵ,v} 中定义的三种未加权损失，以及网络直接输出的三种形式，共有九种可能的组合（表 1）。每种组合都构成一个有效的表述，而九种情形中没有任何两种在数学上等价。

English original
Put together, consider the three unweighted losses defined in {x,ϵ,v}\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}{x,ϵ,v} , and the three forms of the network direct output, there are nine possible combinations ( Tab. 1 ). Each combination constitutes a valid formulation, and no two among the nine cases are mathematically equivalent.
本站讲解：九种组合为什么不能当成同一个目标函数
九种组合都合法，都能转成 v 再解 ODE 采样，但它们是九个不同的训练目标：损失空间不同、网络要拟合的函数不同、权重随 t 的曲线也不同。差别在容易的设定里可以忽略——脚注 3 提到，[52] 在 CIFAR-10 上试了 9 种组合，其中 8 种都工作得不错。差别在高维图块上会放大成灾难：本文实验中，同样的网络换成 ε-或 v-预测就直接崩掉。把“数学上相关”读成“实践上等价”，正是这篇文章想纠正的那一步。

生成器空间。

English original
Generator Space.

无论使用哪种组合，为了在推理时进行生成，我们总可以把网络输出变换到 v\bm{v}v 空间（表 1第 (3) 行），并求解式 4中的 ODE 来完成采样。因此，九种组合都是合法的生成器。

English original
Regardless of the combination used, to perform generation at inference-time, we can always transform the network output to the v\bm{v}v -space ( Tab. 1 , row (3)) and solve the ODE in Eq. 4 for sampling. As such, all nine combinations are legitimate generators.

3.3 玩具实验

English original
3.3 Toy Experiment

依据流形假设[4]，数据 x\bm{x}x 倾向于位于一个低维流形上（图 1），而噪声 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 与速度 v\bm{v}v 位于流形之外。让网络直接预测干净数据 x\bm{x}x 应当更容易处理。本节用一个玩具实验验证这一假设。

English original
According to the manifold assumption [4] , the data x\bm{x}x tends to lie in a low-dimensional manifold ( Fig. 1 ), while noise ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ and velocity v\bm{v}v are off-manifold. Letting a network directly predict the clean data x\bm{x}x should be more tractable. We verify this assumption in a toy experiment in this section.

我们考虑如下玩具情形：ddd 维的潜在数据“埋”在观测到的 DDD 维空间中（d<Dd<Dd<D）。我们用列正交的投影矩阵 P∈RD×dP\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times d}P∈RD×d（即 P⊤P=Id×dP^{\top}P=I_{d\times d}P⊤P=Id×d​）合成这一情形。矩阵 PPP 随机生成并固定。观测数据为 x=Px^∈RD\bm{x}=P\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D}x=Px^∈RD，其中潜在数据为 x^∈Rd\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}x^∈Rd。模型并不知道矩阵 PPP，因此对模型而言这是一个 DDD 维的生成问题。

English original
We consider the toy case of ddd -dimensional underlying data “buried” in an observed DDD -dimensional space ( d<Dd<Dd<D ). We synthesize this scenario using a projection matrix P∈RD×dP\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times d}P∈RD×d that is column-orthogonal, *i.e* . , P⊤P=Id×dP^{\top}P=I_{d\times d}P⊤P=Id×d​ . This matrix PPP is randomly created and fixed. The observed data is x=Px^∈RD\bm{x}=P\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D}x=Px^∈RD , where the underlying data is x^∈Rd\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}x^∈Rd . The matrix PPP is unknown to the model, and as such, it is a DDD -dimensional generation problem for the model.

我们训练一个隐藏单元为 256 维的 5 层 ReLU MLP 作为生成器，结果可视化在图 2中。可视化的做法是用 PPP 把 DDD 维的生成样本投影回 ddd 维。我们考察 d=2d=2d=2 时 D∈{2,8,16,512}D\in\{2,8,16,512\}D∈{2,8,16,512} 的情形。我们研究 x\bm{x}x-、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-、v\bm{v}v-预测，三者都使用 v\bm{v}v-损失，即表 1的 (3)(a-c)。

English original
We train a 5-layer ReLU MLP with 256-dim hidden units as the generator and visualize the results in Fig. 2 . We obtain these visualizations by projecting the DDD -dim generated samples back to ddd -dim using PPP . We investigate the cases of D∈{2,8,16,512}D\in\{2,8,16,512\}D∈{2,8,16,512} for d=2d=2d=2 . We study x\bm{x}x , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ , or v\bm{v}v -prediction, all using the v\bm{v}v -loss, *i.e* . , Tab. 1 (3)(a-c) .

图 2显示，当 DDD 增大时，只有 x\bm{x}x-预测能产生合理的结果。对于 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-/v\bm{v}v-预测，模型在 D=16D{=}16D=16 时已经吃力，在 D=512D{=}512D=512 时灾难性失败——此时 256 维的 MLP 是不完备的（under-complete）。

English original
Fig. 2 shows that only x\bm{x}x -prediction can produce reasonable results when DDD increases . For ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -/ v\bm{v}v -prediction, the models struggle at D=16D{=}16D=16 , and fail catastrophically when D=512D{=}512D=512 , where the 256-dim MLP is under-complete.
本站讲解：这个玩具实验该怎么读
设定是：真实数据只有 d=2 维（一张二维平面上的点），但被一个固定的随机正交矩阵 P 抬到 D 维再交给模型，模型不知道 P。生成出来的 D 维样本再用同一个 P 压回二维画图，这样人眼才能看出形状对不对。D=2 时任务本身只有两维，三种预测都还行；D 增大后，ε 与 v 要求网络在 D 维里精确记住一个高维量，256 维 MLP 装不下，于是塌掉；x 只要求网络落回那张二维薄片，所以即使 MLP 的宽度远小于 D 也够用。边界：这个结论是在 v-损失、5 层 MLP、隐藏维 256 的设定下得到的，它支持作者的假设，但不能直接外推成“任何架构、任何损失下 x-预测都更好”。

值得注意的是，即使模型不完备，x\bm{x}x-预测也能良好工作。这里，256 维的 MLP 在 D=512D{=}512D=512 维空间中不可避免地丢弃信息。然而，由于真实数据位于低维的 ddd 维空间中，x\bm{x}x-预测仍能表现良好，因为理想输出隐含地只是 ddd 维的。我们在 ImageNet 真实数据上也得到类似的观察，如下文所示。

English original
Notably, x\bm{x}x -prediction can work well even when the model is under-complete . Here, the 256-dim MLP inevitably discards information in the D=512D{=}512D=512 -dim space. However, since the true data is in a low-dimensional ddd -dim space, x\bm{x}x -prediction can still perform well, as the ideal output is implicitly ddd -dim. We draw similar observations in the case of real data on ImageNet, as we show next.

4 用于扩散的“Just Image Transformers”

English original
4 “Just Image Transformers” for Diffusion

在上述分析的驱动下，我们表明，直接在像素上运行的普通视觉 Transformer（ViT）[13] 可以工作得惊人地好，且只需使用 x\bm{x}x 预测。

English original
Driven by the above analysis, we show that plain Vision Transformers (ViT) [13] operating on pixels can work surprisingly well, simply using x\bm{x}x -prediction.

4.1 就是图像 Transformer

English original
4.1 Just Image Transformers

ViT [13] 的核心思想是“Transformer on Patches（ToP，作用在 patch 上的 Transformer）”。我们的架构设计遵循这一理念。[2]

English original
The core idea of ViT [13] is “ Transformer on Patches (ToP)’’ . Our architecture design follows this philosophy.

形式上，考虑 H×W×CH{\times}W{\times}CH×W×C 维的图像数据（C=3C{=}3C=3）。所有 x\bm{x}x、ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ、v\bm{v}v 和 zt\bm{z}_{t}zt​ 都具有相同的维度。给定一幅图像，我们将其划分为大小为 p×pp{\times}pp×p 的不重叠 patch，得到一个长度为 Hp×Wp\frac{H}{p}{\times}\frac{W}{p}pH​×pW​ 的序列。每个 patch 是一个 p×p×3p{\times}p{\times}3p×p×3 维向量。该序列经线性嵌入投影处理，加上位置嵌入 [66]，再由一叠 Transformer 块 [66] 映射。输出层是一个线性预测器，把每个 token 投影回 p×p×3p{\times}p{\times}3p×p×3 维的 patch。见图3。

English original
Formally, consider H×W×CH{\times}W{\times}CH×W×C -dim image data ( C=3C{=}3C=3 ). All x\bm{x}x , ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ , v\bm{v}v and zt\bm{z}_{t}zt​ share this same dimensionality. Given an image, we divide it into non-overlapping patches of size p×pp{\times}pp×p , resulting in a sequence of a length Hp×Wp\frac{H}{p}{\times}\frac{W}{p}pH​×pW​ . Each patch is a p×p×3p{\times}p{\times}3p×p×3 -dim vector. This sequence is processed by a linear embedding projection, added with positional embedding [66] , and mapped by a stack of Transformer blocks [66] . The output layer is a linear predictor that projects each token back to a p×p×3p{\times}p{\times}3p×p×3 -dim patch. See Fig. 3 .

按照标准做法，该架构以时间 ttt 和给定类别标签为条件。我们使用 adaLN-Zero [46] 进行条件化，稍后还会讨论其他选项。在概念上，这一架构相当于把扩散 Transformer（DiT）[46] 直接作用于像素 patch。

English original
As standard practice, the architecture is conditioned on time ttt and a given class label. We use adaLN-Zero [46] for conditioning and will discuss other options later. Conceptually, this architecture amounts to the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [46] directly applied to patches of pixels.

整体架构不过是“Just image Transformers”（就是图像 Transformer），我们称之为 JiT。例如，我们在 256×256256{\times}256256×256 图像上研究 JiT/16（即 patch 大小 p=16p{=}16p=16，[13]），在 512×512512{\times}512512×512 图像上研究 JiT/32（p=32p{=}32p=32）。这两种设置下每个 patch 的维度分别为 768（16×16×316{\times}16{\times}316×16×3）和 3072（32×32×332{\times}32{\times}332×32×3）。如此高维的 patch 可以由 x\bm{x}x 预测来处理。

English original
The overall architecture is nothing more than “Just image Transformers”, which we refer to as JiT . For example, we investigate JiT/16 ( *i.e* . , patch size p=16p{=}16p=16 , [13] ) on 256×256256{\times}256256×256 images, and JiT/32 ( p=32p{=}32p=32 ) on 512×512512{\times}512512×512 images. These settings respectively result in a dimensionality of 768 ( 16×16×316{\times}16{\times}316×16×3 ) and 3072 ( 32×32×332{\times}32{\times}332×32×3 ) per patch. Such high-dimensional patches can be handled by x\bm{x}x -prediction.
本站讲解：patch 维度与 token 数的区别
这里有两个容易混淆的量，要分开看。序列长度（token 数）是 (H/p)×(W/p)(H/p)\times(W/p)(H/p)×(W/p)；每个 token 的输入维度是 patch 的像素维度 p×p×3p\times p\times 3p×p×3。JiT/16 在 256 分辨率下序列长 16×16=25616\times16=25616×16=256，但每个 token 是 768 维，也就是“token 不多、每个 token 很宽”。潜空间扩散的情况不同：以常见的 SD-VAE 为例，256×256256\times256256×256 图像先被压成 32×32×432\times32\times432×32×4 的 latent。若按 DiT 的 p=2p=2p=2 切 latent patch，则得到 16×16=25616\times16=25616×16=256 个 token，数量与 JiT/16 的 256 相近，但每个 token 的维度是 2×2×4=162\times2\times4=162×2×4=16，与 768 维相差一个数量级以上。本文后续所有论证都建立在这个宽 token 上；而且分辨率翻倍时 ppp 也翻倍，序列长度仍是 256，计算量基本不变，这正是表5 里 1024 分辨率仍然便宜的原因。这是本文的设计选择，不是“像素扩散必须这样切 patch”的结论。

4.2 网络应当预测什么？

English original
4.2 What to Predict by the Network?

我们在表1中汇总了损失空间与预测空间的九种可能组合。对其中每种组合，我们训练一个“Base” [13] 模型（JiT-B），其每个 token 的隐藏维度为 768。我们在表2(a) 中研究 256×256256{\times}256256×256 分辨率下的 JiT-B/16。作为参照，我们在表2(b) 中考察 64×6464{\times}6464×64 下的 JiT-B/4（即 p=4p{=}4p=4）。两种设置下的序列长度相同（16×{\times}×16）。

English original
We have summarized the nine possible combinations of loss space and prediction space in Tab. 1 . For each of these combinations, we train a “Base” [13] model (JiT-B), which has a hidden size of 768-dim per token. We study JiT-B/16 at 256 ×\times× 256 resolution in Tab. 2 (a). As a reference, we examine JiT-B/4 ( *i.e* . , p=4p{=}4p=4 ) at 64 ×\times× 64 in Tab. 2 (b). In both settings, the sequence length is the same (16 ×{\times}× 16).

我们得出以下观察：

English original
We draw the following observations:

x\bm{x}x 预测至关重要。

English original
x\bm{x}x -prediction is critical.

在表2(a) 的 JiT-B/16 中，只有 x\bm{x}x 预测表现良好，并且它在三种损失下都有效。这里每个 patch 是 768 维（16×16×316{\times}16{\times}316×16×3），恰好与 JiT-B 的 768 维隐藏维度相同。这看似“差不多够用”，但实践中模型可能需要额外的容量，例如用于处理位置嵌入。对于 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ/v\bm{v}v 预测，模型没有足够的容量来分离并保留加噪后的量。这些观察与玩具实验（图2）中的情况类似。

English original
In Tab. 2 (a) with JiT-B/16, only x\bm{x}x -prediction performs well , and it works across all three losses. Here, a patch is 768-d ( 16×16×316{\times}16{\times}316×16×3 ), which coincides with the hidden size of 768 in JiT-B . While this may seem “about enough”, in practice the models may require additional capacity, *e.g* . , to handle positional embeddings. For ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -/ v\bm{v}v -prediction, the model does not have enough capacity to separate and retain the noised quantities. These observations are similar to those in the toy case ( Fig. 2 ).

作为对照，我们考察 64×6464{\times}6464×64 分辨率下的 JiT-B/4（表2(b)）。此时所有情形都表现尚可：九种组合之间的准确度差距是边缘性的，不具决定性。每个 patch 的维度为 48（4×4×34{\times}4{\times}34×4×3），远低于 JiT-B 的 768 维隐藏维度，这解释了为何所有组合都能正常工作。我们注意到，许多先前的潜空间扩散模型具有同样小的输入维度，因此没有暴露于我们此处讨论的问题。

English original
As a comparison, we examine JiT-B/4 at 64 ×\times× 64 resolution ( Tab. 2 (b)). Here, all cases perform reasonably well: the accuracy gaps among the nine combinations are marginal, not decisive. The dimensionality is 48 ( 4×4×34{\times}4{\times}34×4×3 ) per patch, well below the hidden size of 768 in JiT-B , which explains why all combinations work reasonably well. We note that many previous latent diffusion models have a similarly small input dimensionality and therefore were not exposed to the issue we discuss here.

损失加权并不足够。

English original
Loss weighting is not sufficient.

我们的工作并非首次枚举相关因素的组合。文献 [52] 探索了损失加权与网络预测的组合。他们的实验在低维的 CIFAR-10 数据集上使用 U-net 完成。他们的观察更接近我们在 ImageNet 64×6464{\times}6464×64 上的结果。[3]

English original
Our work is not the first to enumerate the combinations of relevant factors. In [52] , it has explored the combinations of loss weighting and network predictions. Their experiments were done on the low-dimensional CIFAR-10 dataset, using a U-net. Their observations were closer to ours on ImageNet 64 ×\times× 64.

然而，ImageNet 256×256256{\times}256256×256 上的表2(a) 表明，损失加权并不是全部。一方面，无论损失空间如何，ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 预测与 v\bm{v}v 预测在表2(a) 中都灾难性地失败，而不同损失空间对应着不同的有效加权（如前所述）。另一方面，x\bm{x}x 预测在全部三种损失空间下都有效：v\bm{v}v 损失所诱导的损失加权更可取，但并不关键。[4]

English original
However, Tab. 2 (a) on ImageNet 256 ×\times× 256 suggests that loss weighting is not the whole story . On one hand, both ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ - and v\bm{v}v -prediction fail catastrophically in Tab. 2 (a), regardless of the loss space, which corresponds to different effective weightings in different loss spaces (as discussed). On the other hand, x\bm{x}x -prediction works across all three loss spaces: the loss weighting induced by the v\bm{v}v -loss is preferable, but not critical.

噪声水平平移并不足够。

English original
Noise-level shift is not sufficient.

先前工作 [7]、[25]、[26] 提出，提高噪声水平对高分辨率像素扩散有益。我们用 JiT-B/16 在表3中考察这一点。由于我们使用 logit 正态分布 [15] 采样 ttt（见附录），可以通过改变该分布的参数 μ\muμ 来平移噪声水平：直观上，把 μ\muμ 向负方向移动会得到更小的 ttt，从而提高噪声水平（式1）。

English original
Prior works [ [7] , [25] , [26] ] have suggested that increasing the noise level is useful for high-resolution pixel-based diffusion. We examine this in Tab. 3 with JiT-B/16. As we use the logit-normal distribution [15] for sampling ttt (see appendix), the noise level can be shifted by changing the parameter μ\muμ of this distribution: intuitively, shifting μ\muμ towards the negative side results in smaller ttt and thus increases the noise level ( Eq. 1 ).

表3显示，当模型本已表现尚可（此处为 x\bm{x}x 预测）时，适当高的噪声是有益的，这与先前的观察 [7]、[25]、[26] 一致。然而，仅调整噪声水平无法挽救 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 或 v\bm{v}v 预测：它们的失败本质上源于无法传递高维信息。

English original
Tab. 3 shows that when the model already performs decently (here, x\bm{x}x -pred ), appropriately high noise is beneficial, which is consistent with prior observations [ [7] , [25] , [26] ] . However, adjusting the noise level alone cannot remedy ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ - or v\bm{v}v -prediction: their failure stems inherently from the inability to propagate high-dimensional information.

附带说明，根据表3，我们在 ImageNet 256×256256{\times}256256×256 的其他实验中设置 μ\muμ = –0.8。

English original
As a side note, according to Tab. 3 , we set μ\muμ = –0.8 in other experiments on ImageNet 256 ×\times× 256.

增加隐藏单元并非必要。

English original
Increasing hidden units is not necessary.

由于容量可能受网络宽度（即隐藏单元数量）限制，一个自然的想法是增加宽度。然而，当观测维度非常高时，这种补救既缺乏原理依据，也不可行。我们表明，在 x\bm{x}x 预测的情形下这并无必要。

English original
Since the capacity can be limited by the network width ( *i.e* . , numbers of hidden units), a natural idea is to increase it. However, this remedy is neither principled nor feasible when the observed dimension is very high. We show that this is not necessary in the case of x\bm{x}x -prediction.

在下一节的表5和表6中，我们给出分辨率 512 下 JiT/32 与分辨率 1024 下 JiT/64 的结果，使用按比例放大的 patch 大小 p=32p{=}32p=32 或 p=64p{=}64p=64。这相当于每个 patch 3072 维（即 32×32×332{\times}32{\times}332×32×3）或 12288 维，远大于 B、L、H 模型的隐藏维度（定义见 [13]）。尽管如此，x\bm{x}x 预测依然工作良好；事实上，除了按比例缩放噪声（例如在分辨率 512 和 1024 下分别放大 2 倍和 4 倍；见附录）之外，它无需任何修改。

English original
In Tab. 5 and Tab. 6 in the next section, we show results of JiT/32 at resolution 512 and JiT/64 at resolution 1024, using a proportionally large patch size of p=32p{=}32p=32 or p=64p{=}64p=64 . This amounts to 3072-dim ( *i.e* . , 32×32×332{\times}32{\times}332×32×3 ) or 12288-dim per patch, substantially larger than the hidden size of B, L, and H models (defined in [13] ). Nevertheless, x\bm{x}x -prediction works well; in fact, it works without any modification other than scaling the noise proportionally ( *e.g* . , by 2 ×\times× and 4 ×\times× at resolution 512 and 1024; see appendix).

这一证据表明，网络设计可以在很大程度上与观测维度解耦，正如许多其他神经网络应用中的情形。增加隐藏单元数量可能有益（这在深度学习中已被广泛观察到），但它不是决定性的。

English original
This evidence suggests that the network design can be largely decoupled from the observed dimensionality, as is the case in many other neural network applications. Increasing the number of hidden units can be beneficial (as widely observed in deep learning), but it is not decisive.

瓶颈可以带来收益。

English original
Bottleneck can be beneficial.

更令人意外的是，我们发现反过来也成立：在网络中引入降低维度的瓶颈可以带来收益。

English original
Even more surprisingly, we find that, conversely, introducing a bottleneck that reduces dimensionality in the network can be beneficial.

具体来说，我们把线性的 patch 嵌入层变成低秩线性层，方法是将其替换为一对瓶颈（但仍然线性）的层。第一层把维度降到 d′d^{\prime}d′，第二层再扩展到 Transformer 的隐藏维度。两层都是线性的，构成一种低秩重参数化。

English original
Specifically, we turn the linear patch embedding layer into a low-rank linear layer, by replacing it with a pair of bottleneck (yet still linear) layers. The first layer reduces the dimension to d′d^{\prime}d′ , and the second layer expands it to the hidden size of the Transformer. Both layers are linear and serve as a low-rank reparameterization.

图4 画出 FID 随瓶颈维度 d′d^{\prime}d′ 的变化，使用 JiT-B/16（每个原始 patch 768 维）。降低瓶颈维度，即使小到 16 维，也不会导致灾难性失败。事实上，瓶颈维度在很宽的范围（32 到 512）内都能提升质量，幅度可观，最高约 ∼\scriptstyle\sim∼ 1.3 FID。

English original
Fig. 4 plots the FID *vs* . the bottleneck dimension d′d^{\prime}d′ , using JiT-B/16 (768-d per raw patch). Reducing the bottleneck dimension, even to as small as 16-d, does not cause catastrophic failure. In fact, a bottleneck dimension across a wide range (32 to 512) can improve the quality, by a decent margin of up to ∼\scriptstyle\sim∼ 1.3 FID.
本站讲解：瓶颈为什么会有用
原始 patch 嵌入是一个 768×768768\times768768×768 的线性层（JiT-B 的隐藏维度为 768）。作者把它换成 768→d′768\to d^{\prime}768→d′ 与 d′→768d^{\prime}\to768d′→768 两个线性层，中间维度按附录配置取 128（B/L）或 256（H/G）。这等价于把原来的嵌入矩阵约束成秩不超过 d′d^{\prime}d′ 的低秩矩阵，参数量从约 7682768^27682 降到约 2×768×d′2\times768\times d^{\prime}2×768×d′，同时强迫网络先把宽 patch 压到低维再展开。图4 的扫描显示，d′d^{\prime}d′ 从无瓶颈（等价于 768）一路降到 16 都不会崩，32 到 512 区间内，FID 最多可改善约 1.3（64 维时比无瓶颈低 1.27）。作者用表征学习的文献解释这一点：低维表征更容易学。需要区分的是，这是“在此设置下观测到瓶颈有益”，不是“低秩嵌入普遍优于满秩”的定理；d′d^{\prime}d′ 进一步变小时收益会消失，具体边界只能看图4。

从表征学习的更广视角看，这一观察并不完全出人意料。瓶颈设计常被引入以促进学习内在低维的表征 [64]、[48]、[41]、[2]。

English original
From a broader perspective of representation learning, this observation is not entirely unexpected. Bottleneck designs are often introduced to encourage the learning of inherently low-dimensional representations [ [64] , [48] , [41] , [2] ] .

4.3 我们的算法

English original
4.3 Our Algorithm

我们最终的算法采用 x\bm{x}x 预测与 v\bm{v}v 损失，对应表1的 (3)(a)。形式上，我们优化：

English original
Our final algorithm adopts x\bm{x}x -prediction and v\bm{v}v -loss, which corresponds to Tab. 1 (3)(a) . Formally, we optimize:
本站讲解：为什么可以“输出 x、用 v 损失”
这是全文最容易读错的一处。网络 netθ\texttt{net}_\thetanetθ​ 的输出被直接当作 x\bm{x}x，即 xθ=netθ(zt,t)\bm{x}_\theta=\texttt{net}_\theta(\bm{z}_t,t)xθ​=netθ​(zt​,t)；但训练目标写成 v\bm{v}v 损失：先把输出换算成 vθ=(netθ−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}_\theta=(\texttt{net}_\theta-\bm{z}_t)/(1-t)vθ​=(netθ​−zt​)/(1−t)，再与真值 v=x−ϵ\bm{v}=\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}v=x−ϵ 做均方误差。由 zt=tx+(1−t)ϵ\bm{z}_t=t\bm{x}+(1-t)\bm{\epsilon}zt​=tx+(1−t)ϵ 可验证 v=(x−zt)/(1−t)\bm{v}=(\bm{x}-\bm{z}_t)/(1-t)v=(x−zt​)/(1−t)，所以这个换算不改变网络结构，只是把同一个预测换一种参数化后再计损失。效果是：v\bm{v}v 损失等价于对 x\bm{x}x 损失施加 1/(1−t)21/(1-t)^21/(1−t)2 的权重（§3 与相应脚注），越靠近干净端 t→1t\to1t→1 权重越大。这里不要过度解读：它不构成“x\bm{x}x 预测普遍优于 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ/v\bm{v}v 预测”的定理；表2 的实证结果只在宽 patch（768 维）设置下成立，64×64、48 维时九种组合的差距很小。
公式 (6) · 读法
L=Et,x,ϵ∥vθ(zt,t)−v∥2,where:vθ(zt,t)=(netθ(zt,t)−zt)/(1−t).\begin{gathered}\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}_{t,\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon}}\Big\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\Big\|^{2},\\[4pt]\text{where:}\quad\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=(\text{net}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t).\end{gathered}L=Et,x,ϵ​​vθ​(zt​,t)−v​2,where:vθ​(zt​,t)=(netθ​(zt​,t)−zt​)/(1−t).​
\begin{gathered}\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}_{t,\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon}}\Big\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\Big\|^{2},\\[4pt]\text{where:}\quad\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=(\text{net}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t).\end{gathered}

这就是 JiT 的实际目标：网络输出干净图像 xθ=netθ(zt,t)\bm{x}_\theta=\text{net}_\theta(\bm{z}_t,t)xθ​=netθ​(zt​,t)，再换算成 vθ\bm{v}_\thetavθ​ 去匹配 v\bm{v}v，对应表 1 的 (3)(a)。下面的推导会说明，它等价于对 x\bm{x}x-MSE 乘权重 1/(1−t)21/(1-t)^21/(1−t)2。

English original
L=Et,x,ϵ∥vθ(zt,t)−v∥2,\displaystyle\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}_{t,\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon}}\Big\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\Big\|^{2},L=Et,x,ϵ​​vθ​(zt​,t)−v​2, (6) where:vθ(zt,t)=(netθ(zt,t)−zt)/(1−t).\displaystyle\text{where:}\quad\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=(\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t).where:vθ​(zt​,t)=(netθ​(zt​,t)−zt​)/(1−t).

算法1 给出一个训练步的伪代码，算法2 是采样步的伪代码（欧拉求解器；可扩展到 Heun 或其他求解器）。为简洁起见，类别条件与 CFG [22] 被省略，但二者都遵循标准做法。为避免 1/(1−t)1{/}(1{-}t)1/(1−t) 中的除零，我们在计算该除法时对其分母做裁剪（默认 0.05）。

English original
Alg. 1 shows the pseudo-code of a training step, and Alg. 2 is that of a sampling step (Euler solver; can be extended to Heun or other solvers). For brevity, class conditioning and CFG [22] are omitted, but both follow standard practice. To prevent zero division in 1/(1−t)1{/}(1{-}t)1/(1−t) , we clip its denominator (by default, 0.05) whenever computing this division.

4.4 “Just Advanced” Transformer（进阶版 Transformer）

English original
4.4 “Just Advanced” Transformers

通用 Transformer [66] 的优势部分在于：当其设计与具体任务解耦时，它可以受益于在其他应用中发展出来的架构进步。这一性质正是用任务无关的 Transformer 来表述扩散的优势所在。

English original
The strength of a general-purpose Transformer [66] is partly in that, when its design is decoupled from the specific task, it can benefit from architectural advances developed in other applications. This property underpins the advantage of formulating diffusion with a task-agnostic Transformer.

遵循 [73]，我们引入了流行的通用改进：SwiGLU [54]、RMSNorm [75]、RoPE [62]、qk-norm [19]，它们最初都是为语言模型开发的。我们还探索了 in-context 类别条件：但与原始 ViT [13] 在序列中追加一个类别 token 不同，我们追加多个这样的 token（默认 32 个；见附录），遵循 [35]。表4 报告了这些组件的效果。[5]

English original
Following [73] , we incorporate popular general-purpose improvements : SwiGLU [54] , RMSNorm [75] , RoPE [62] , qk-norm [19] , all of which were originally developed for language models. We also explore in-context class conditioning: but unlike original ViT [13] that appends one class token to the sequence, we appends multiple such tokens (by default, 32; see appendix), following [35] . Tab. 4 reports the effects of these components.
本站讲解：被搬进来的“通用改进”有哪些
本节把语言模型里的常用组件直接用到扩散 Transformer 上：SwiGLU 替换 MLP 的激活结构，RMSNorm 替换 LayerNorm，RoPE 提供位置信息，qk-norm 约束注意力的 query/key。类别条件则做成 in-context 的 32 个类别 token（不是 ViT 的单个 cls token）；按附录，这些 token 并非都加在第 0 层，而是从第 4/8/10 层开始插入（B/L/H/G 分别为 4、8、10、10）。表4（200 epoch，带 CFG）给出的数字是：基线 7.48，加 RoPE 与 qk-norm 后 6.69，再加 in-context 类别 token 后 5.49；括号内为使用 CFG interval 的 4.37。要注意这是累积式消融，没有逐项单独归因，不能把它读成每个组件都有独立的定量贡献。

5 对比

English original
5 Comparisons

像素上的高分辨率生成。

English original
High-resolution generation on pixels.

在表5中，我们进一步报告 base 规模模型（JiT-B）在 ImageNet 分辨率 512 乃至 1024 上的结果。我们使用与图像尺寸成比例的 patch 大小，因此不同分辨率下的序列长度保持不变。每个 patch 的维度可高达 3072 或 12288，而常见的模型都不具备足够的隐藏单元。

English original
In Tab. 5 , we further report our base -size model (JiT-B) on ImageNet at resolutions 512 and even 1024. We use patch sizes proportional to image sizes, and therefore the sequence length at different resolutions remains the same. The per-patch dimension can be as high as 3072 or 12288, and none of the common models would have sufficient hidden units.

表5显示，我们的模型在各分辨率下都表现尚可。所有模型具有相近的参数量和计算代价，只在输入/输出 patch 嵌入上不同。我们的方法不受“观测维度之咒”（curse of observed dimensionalities）的影响。

English original
Tab. 5 shows that our models perform decently across resolutions. All models have similar numbers of parameters and computational cost, which only differ in the input/output patch embeddings. Our method does not suffer from the curse of observed dimensionalities.

可扩展性。

English original
Scalability.

将 Transformer 设计与任务解耦的一个核心目标，是利用可扩展性的潜力。表6给出四种模型规模在 ImageNet 256 和 512 上的结果（注意在分辨率 512 下，这些模型的隐藏单元数都不超过 patch 维度）。模型规模与 FLOPs 见表7和表8：我们在分辨率 256 的模型与其 512 对应模型的代价相近。我们的方法受益于规模化。

English original
A core goal of decoupling the Transformer design with the task is to leverage the potential for scalability. Tab. 6 provides results on ImageNet 256 and 512 with four model sizes (note that at resolution 512, none of these models have more hidden units than the patch dimension). The model sizes and flops are shown in Tab. 8 and 8 : our model at resolution 256 has similar cost as its counterpart at 512. Our approach benefits from scaling.
本站讲解：参数量与 FLOPs 的统计口径
表7/表8 的口径写在表注里：参数包含生成器与推理时会用到的 tokenizer 解码器，不含其他预训练组件；GFLOPs 是单次前向（不计 tokenizer）的测量值，大致正比于训练与推理一次迭代的计算量，多尺度方法取最细一级。因此 JiT-B/16 的 131M 参数、25 GFLOPs 与 JiT-B/32 的 133M 参数、26 GFLOPs 几乎相同，这正是“序列长度不变、只有输入输出嵌入变大”的直接后果。反过来，像素扩散的对照方法数字更大（例如 ADM-G 为 1120 GFLOPs），部分原因是它们在高分辨率上用更长序列或更大网络，不能只看 FLOPs 一列就断定方法优劣；作者用它论证的是“代价不随分辨率二次增长”，不是全面效率最优。另：正文此处引用表7和表8，arXiv HTML 把第一处误写成 Tab. 8，以 PDF/TeX 为准。

有趣的是，分辨率 256 与 512 之间的 FID 差距随模型变大而缩小。对 JiT-G 而言，512 分辨率下的 FID 甚至更低。对 ImageNet 上的超大模型来说，FID 表现在很大程度上取决于过拟合，而 512 分辨率下的去噪是一个更难的任务，因此更不易过拟合。

English original
Interestingly, the FID difference between resolution 256 and 512 becomes smaller with larger models. For JiT-G, the FID at 512 resolution is even lower. For very large models on ImageNet, FID performance largely depends on overfitting, and denoising at 512 resolution poses a more challenging task, making it less susceptible to overfitting.
本站讲解：JiT-G 的“600 epoch”其实是约 320 epoch 早停
表6 两列标为 200 epoch 与 600 epoch，但附录“Dropout and early stop”说明：H 与 G 在 Transformer 块中间一半加 dropout，G 规模仍会过拟合，于是在监控 FID 开始变差时早停，JiT-G/16 与 JiT-G/32 都在约 320 epoch 触发。也就是说，G 的两项（256 下 1.82、512 下 1.78）不是真训满 600 epoch 的结果，而是约 320 epoch 的检查点；B/L/H 才按 600 epoch 训练。这会影响“G 是否还能靠更长训练继续降 FID”的判断：1.82/1.78 应理解为早停后的最优监控值，不能与其它方法的 600 epoch 预算直接对齐。表注没有重复这一点，读表时容易漏。[早停事实来自附录；由此推出“G 未训满 600 epoch”是结合配置表 epochs=600 与附录早停描述得到的，属于推断。]

先前工作的参考结果。

English original
Reference results from previous works.

作为参照，我们在表7和表8中与先前结果比较。我们标出每种方法所涉及的预训练组件。与其他基于像素的方法相比，我们的方法完全由普通的、通用的 Transformer 驱动。我们的模型计算友好，避免了分辨率翻倍时代价的二次增长（FLOPs 见表8）。

English original
As a reference, we compare with previous results in Tab. 8 and 8 . We mark the pre-training components involved for each method. Compared with other pixel-based methods, ours is purely driven by plain , general-purpose Transformers. Our models are compute-friendly and avoid the quadratic scaling of expense with doubled resolution (see flops in Tab. 8 ).

我们的方法不使用额外损失或预训练，而这两者可能带来进一步的收益（附录中有一个例子）。这些方向留待未来工作。

English original
Our approach does not use extra losses or pre-training, which may lead to further gains (an example is in appendix). These directions are left for future work.

6 讨论与结论

English original
6 Discussion and Conclusion

噪声与自然数据本质上不同。多年来，扩散模型的发展主要集中于概率建模形式，而对所用神经网络的能力（及其局限）关注较少。然而，神经网络并非能力无限，它们可以更好地把容量用于建模数据而不是噪声。在这些视角下，我们关于 x\bm{x}x 预测的发现，事后看来是自然的结果。

English original
Noise is inherently different from natural data . Over the years, the development of diffusion models has focused primarily on probabilistic formulations, while paying less attention to the capabilities (and limitations) of the neural networks used. However, neural networks are not infinitely capable, and they can better use their capacity to model data rather than noise. Under these perspectives, our findings on x\bm{x}x -prediction are, in hindsight, a natural outcome.

我们的工作采用极简且自洽的设计。通过减少领域特定的归纳偏置，我们希望该方法能推广到难以获得 tokenizer 的其他领域。这一性质对涉及原始、高维自然数据的科学应用尤为可取。我们设想，通用的“扩散 + Transformer”范式有望成为其他领域的基础框架。

English original
Our work adopts a minimalist and self-contained design. By reducing domain-specific inductive biases, we hope our approach can generalize to other domains where tokenizers are difficult to obtain. This property is particularly desirable for scientific applications that involve raw, high-dimensional natural data. We envision that the general-purpose “Diffusion + Transformer” paradigm will be a potential foundation in other areas.

附录 A 实现细节

English original
Appendix A Implementation Details

我们的实现紧密遵循 DiT [46] 与 SiT [40] 的公开代码库。我们的配置汇总于 表 9。细节描述如下。

English original
Our implementation closely follows the public codebases of DiT [46] and SiT [40] . Our configurations are summarized in Tab. 9 . We describe the details as follows.

时间分布。

English original
Time distribution.

遵循 [15]，训练时我们在 ttt 上采用 logit-normal 分布 [15]：logit(t)∼N(μ,σ2)\text{logit}(t)\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})logit(t)∼N(μ,σ2)。具体而言，我们采样 s∼N(μ,σ2)s\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})s∼N(μ,σ2) 并令 t=sigmoid(s)t{=}\text{sigmoid}(s)t=sigmoid(s)。超参数 μ\muμ 决定噪声水平（见 表 3）；默认在 ImageNet 上对分辨率 256（或 512、1024）取 μ=−0.8\mu=-0.8μ=−0.8，并固定 σ\sigmaσ 为 0.8。

English original
Following [15] , during training, we adopt the logit-normal distribution over ttt [15] : logit(t)∼N(μ,σ2)\text{logit}(t)\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})logit(t)∼N(μ,σ2) . Specifically, we sample s∼N(μ,σ2)s\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})s∼N(μ,σ2) and let t=sigmoid(s)t{=}\text{sigmoid}(s)t=sigmoid(s) . The hyper-parameter μ\muμ determines the noise level (see Tab. 3 ), and by default we set μ\muμ = –0.8 on ImageNet at resolution 256 (or 512, 1024), and fix σ\sigmaσ as 0.8.

ImageNet 512×512 与 1024×1024。

English original
ImageNet 512 ×{\times}× 512 and 1024 ×{\times}× 1024.

在 ImageNet 512 ×{\times}× 512 上我们采用 JiT/32（*即* patch 大小为 32）。模型得到 256 = 16 ×\times× 16 个 patch 的序列，与 ImageNet 256 ×{\times}× 256 上 JiT/16 的序列相同。因此，JiT/32 与 JiT/16 的唯一区别在于输入/输出 patch 的维度，由每 patch 768 维增至 3072 维；其余所有计算与开销完全一致。

English original
We adopt JiT/32 ( *i.e* . , a patch size of 32) on ImageNet 512 ×{\times}× 512. The model leads to a sequence of 256 = 16 ×\times× 16 patches, the same as JiT/16 on ImageNet 256 ×{\times}× 256. As such, JiT/32 only differs from JiT/16 in the input/output patch dimension, increasing from 768-d to 3072-d per patch; all other computations and costs are exactly the same.

为了复用 ImageNet 256 ×{\times}× 256 的完全相同配方，对 512 ×{\times}× 512 图像我们把噪声 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 的幅度放大 2 倍：即 ϵ∼N(0,22I)\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,2^{2}\mathbf{I})ϵ∼N(0,22I)。这一简单改动近似保持了 256 ×{\times}× 256 与 512 ×{\times}× 512 分辨率之间的信噪比（SNR） [[25], [7], [26]]。ImageNet 256 ×{\times}× 256 的配置不需要、也没有施加任何其他改动。

English original
To reuse the exact same recipe from ImageNet 256 ×{\times}× 256, for 512 ×{\times}× 512 images we rescale the magnitude of the noise ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ by 2 ×\times× : that is, ϵ∼N(0,22I)\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,2^{2}\mathbf{I})ϵ∼N(0,22I) . This simple modification approximately maintains the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) between the 256 ×{\times}× 256 and 512 ×{\times}× 512 resolutions [ [25] , [7] , [26] ] . No other changes to the ImageNet 256 ×{\times}× 256 configuration are required or applied.

对 ImageNet 1024 ×{\times}× 1024，我们使用 JiT/64 模型，并把噪声 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 放大 4 ×\times×。无需其他改动。

English original
For ImageNet 1024 ×{\times}× 1024, we use the model JiT/64 and scale the noise ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ by 4 ×\times× . No other change is needed.
本站讲解：为什么只改噪声幅度就能复用 256 的配方
这一节给出的是工程上的迁移做法，不是新的理论。512 用 patch 32，得到 16×\times×16 = 256 个 patch，与 256 分辨率下的 JiT/16 相同（原文明确写出，并称“其余计算与开销完全一致”）；1024 用 patch 64 按同一条除法也是每边 16 个 patch。剩下的变量是噪声幅度：作者把 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ 的方差从 1 放大到 222^222（1024 时 424^242），并称这样近似保持了两种分辨率之间的 SNR，引用 [25, 7, 26]。原文没有给出推导，也没有解释为何恰好是 2 倍和 4 倍，因此这里能得到的是“这套配方在这三种分辨率间可迁移”，而不是“任何分辨率都能无损复用”。

上下文内类别条件。

English original
In-context class conditioning.

标准 DiT [46] 通过 adaLN-Zero 实现类别条件。在 表 4 中，我们进一步探索了上下文内（in-context）类别条件。

English original
Standard DiT [46] performs class conditioning through adaLN-Zero. In Tab. 4 , we further explore in-context class-conditioning.

具体而言，遵循 ViT [13]，可以把一个类别 token 前置到 patch 序列之前。DiT [46] 称之为“上下文内条件”（in-context conditioning）。注意，与 DiT 不同，我们把这套上下文内条件与默认的 adaLN-Zero 条件联合使用。此外，遵循 MAR [35]，我们进一步向序列前置多个这样的 token。这些 token 是同一类别 token 的重复实例，各自加上不同的位置编码。我们前置 32 个这样的 token。并且，我们不是把这些 token 前置到 Transformer 的输入端，而是发现在更靠后的 block 处前置它们可能更有利（见 表 9 中的“in-context start block”）。表 4 显示，我们的上下文内条件实现把 FID 改善了约 1.2。

English original
Specifically, following ViT [13] , one can prepend a class token to the sequence of patches. This is referred to as “in-context conditioning” in DiT [46] . Note that we use in-context conditioning jointly with the default adaLN-Zero conditioning, unlike DiT. In addition, following MAR [35] , we further prepend multiple such tokens to the sequence. These tokens are repeated instances of the same class token, with different positional embeddings added. We prepend 32 such tokens. Moreover, rather than prepending these tokens to the Transformer’s input, we find that prepending them at later blocks can be beneficial (see “in-context start block” in Tab. 9 ). Tab. 4 shows that our implementation of in-context conditioning improves FID by ∼\scriptstyle\sim∼ 1.2.

Dropout 与早停。

English original
Dropout and early stop.

我们在 JiT-H 与 JiT-G 中应用 dropout [61] 以缓解过拟合风险。具体而言，我们对 Transformer block 的中间一半施加 dropout。对这些带 dropout 的 Transformer block，我们在 attention block 与 MLP block 上都施加。

English original
We apply dropout [61] in JiT-H and G to mitigate the risk of overfitting. Specifically, we apply dropout to the middle half of the Transformer blocks. For Transformer blocks with dropout, we apply it to both the attention block and the MLP block.

由于 G 规模模型在我们当前的 dropout 设置下仍倾向于过拟合，当监控的 FID 开始变差时我们启用早停。对 JiT-G/16 与 JiT-G/32，这大约发生在 320 个 epoch。

English original
As the G-size models still tend to overfit under our current dropout setting, we apply early stopping when the monitored FID begins to degrade. This occurs at around 320 epochs for both JiT-G/16 and JiT-G/32.
本站讲解：早停是实际的训练终止条件，不是超参数装饰
G 规模模型在“中间一半 block 加 dropout”之后仍然过拟合，于是训练在监控 FID 开始变差时停止，JiT-G/16 与 JiT-G/32 都大约停在 320 epoch。这一点对复现有直接影响：G 模型的训练长度由验证曲线决定，不是一个固定 epoch 数；照搬 320 这个数字只是在复现作者当时观察到的停止点。原文没有说明监控 FID 的评估频率与所用样本量，这里也不替它补。

EMA 与 CFG。

English original
EMA and CFG.

我们的研究覆盖很宽的配置范围，包括损失与预测空间的变体、模型规模以及架构组件。CFG scale [22] 与 EMA（指数滑动平均）衰减的最优值因情形而异，固定它们可能带来不完整或有误导性的观察结果。由于维护这些超参数配置的成本相对较低，我们力求采用最优值。

English original
Our study covers a wide range of configurations, including variations in loss and prediction spaces, model sizes, and architectural components. The optimal values of the CFG scale [22] and EMA (exponential moving average) decay vary from case to case, and fixing them may lead to incomplete or misleading observations. Since maintaining these hyperparameter configurations is relatively inexpensive, we strive to adopt the optimal values.

具体而言，对 CFG scale ω\omegaω [22]，我们按照现有工作的常见做法，在推理时于一组候选 scale 上搜索以确定最优值。对 EMA 衰减，我们在训练期间维护多份滑动平均参数的副本，这引入的计算开销可忽略。为避免内存开销，不同的 EMA 副本可以存放在不同设备（*例如* GPU）上。因此，CFG scale 与 EMA 衰减本质上都是推理时的决定。

English original
Specifically, for the CFG scale ω\omegaω [22] , we determine the optimal value by searching over a range of candidate scales at inference time, as is common practice in existing work. For EMA decays, we maintain multiple copies of the moving-averaged parameters during training, which introduces a negligible computational overhead. To avoid memory overhead, different EMA copies can be stored on separate devices ( *e.g* . , GPUs). As such, both the CFG scale and EMA decay are essentially inference-time decisions.

我们的 CFG scale 候选从 1.0 到 4.0、步长 0.1。以 JiT-L/16 模型展示的 CFG 影响见 图 6。我们的 EMA 衰减候选为 0.9996、0.9998 与 0.9999，以批大小 1024 评估。对每个模型（包括消融中的任意一个），我们用 8K 样本搜索最优设置，再将其用于评估 50K 样本。

English original
Our CFG scale candidates range from 1.0 to 4.0 with a step size of 0.1. The influence of CFG is shown in Fig. 6 for a JiT-L/16 model. Our EMA decay candidates are 0.9996, 0.9998, and 0.9999, evaluated with a batch size of 1024. For each model (including any one in the ablation), we search for the optimal setting using 8K samples and then apply it to evaluate 50K samples.
本站讲解：CFG 与 EMA 为什么逐模型搜索
附录把 CFG scale 与 EMA 衰减都归为推理时的决定：CFG 在推理时搜索，EMA 在训练时并行保留多份副本（可分散到不同 GPU），因此两者都不改变训练目标。具体网格为 ω∈[1.0,4.0]\omega\in[1.0,4.0]ω∈[1.0,4.0]、步长 0.1，EMA 取 0.9996/0.9998/0.9999。关键的一条是评估协议：每个模型（包括消融里的每一个）都用 8K 样本选出最优设置，再在 50K 样本上报告。这意味着表 2 (a) 的 3×3 组合比较是“每种配置各自调到最好后”的比较，而不是所有配置共用一个 CFG。反过来说，固定 ω\omegaω 比较不同配置，并不对应它们各自可达到的最优性能。

评估。

English original
Evaluation.

遵循常见做法，我们针对 ImageNet 训练集评估 FID [21]。我们在 50K 张生成图像上评估 FID，1000 个 ImageNet 类别每类 50 张样本。我们在同一批 50K 图像上评估 Inception Score（IS）[53]。

English original
Following common pratice, we evaluate the FID [21] against the ImageNet training set. We evaluate FID on 50K generated images, with 50 samples for each of the 1000 ImageNet classes. We evaluate the Inception Score (IS) [53] on the same 50K images.

B.2 预条件器

English original
B.2 Pre-conditioner

在 EDM [29] 中，额外的“预条件器”（pre-conditioner）被用来包裹网络的直接输出。用本文记号，预条件器的形式可写为：xθ(zt,t)=cskip⋅zt+cout⋅netθ(zt,t)\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=c_{\text{skip}}\cdot\bm{z}_{t}+c_{\text{out}}\cdot\text{net}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)xθ​(zt​,t)=cskip​⋅zt​+cout​⋅netθ​(zt​,t)，其中 cskipc_{\text{skip}}cskip​ 与 coutc_{\text{out}}cout​ 是预定义系数。该式表明，除非 cskip≡0c_{\text{skip}}\equiv 0cskip​≡0，预条件器中的网络输出必定不执行 x\bm{x}x-预测。而根据流形假设，这种形式不应能解决我们所考虑的问题，下面我们对此加以检验。

English original
In EDM [29] , an extra “pre-conditioner” is applied to wrap the direct output of the network. Using the notation of our paper, the pre-conditioner formulation can be written as: xθ(zt,t)=cskip⋅zt+cout⋅netθ(zt,t)\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=c_{\text{skip}}\cdot\bm{z}_{t}+c_{\text{out}}\cdot\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)xθ​(zt​,t)=cskip​⋅zt​+cout​⋅netθ​(zt​,t) , where cskipc_{\text{skip}}cskip​ and coutc_{\text{out}}cout​ are pre-defined coefficients. This equation suggests that unless cskip≡0c_{\text{skip}}\equiv 0cskip​≡0 , the network output in a pre-conditioner must not perform x\bm{x}x -prediction. And according to the manifold assumption, this formulation should not remedy the issue we consider, as we examine next.
本站讲解：预条件器为什么在结构上就做不了 x-prediction
把 EDM 的写法搬过来：xθ=cskipzt+coutnetθ\bm{x}_{\theta}=c_{\text{skip}}\bm{z}_t+c_{\text{out}}\text{net}_{\theta}xθ​=cskip​zt​+cout​netθ​。网络输出先乘 coutc_{\text{out}}cout​ 再与 zt\bm{z}_tzt​ 的缩放项相加，只要 cskip≠0c_{\text{skip}}\neq 0cskip​=0，网络输出的角色就是“残差”，它单独并不等于对干净图像的预测。要让 netθ\text{net}_{\theta}netθ​ 真正承担 x\bm{x}x-预测，必须 cskip≡0c_{\text{skip}}\equiv 0cskip​≡0、cout≡1c_{\text{out}}\equiv 1cout​≡1，那预条件器本身就退化为恒等映射。这是原文这一段的论证，属于形式上的观察。

与 式 6 相比，唯一的区别在于我们如何由网络计算 xθ\bm{x}_{\theta}xθ​。

English original
Comparing with Eq. 6 , the only difference is in how we compute xθ\bm{x}_{\theta}xθ​ from the network.

由于 EDM [29] 使用方差爆炸（variance-exploding）调度（即 zt=x+σtϵ\bm{z}_{t}{=}\bm{x}{+}\sigma_{t}\bm{\epsilon}zt​=x+σt​ϵ），而我们使用（大致）方差保持的版本（即 zt=tx+(1−t)ϵ\bm{z}_{t}{=}t\bm{x}{+}(1{-}t)\bm{\epsilon}zt​=tx+(1−t)ϵ），完全等价的转换是不可能的。为了在我们的情形下得到预条件器，我们把我们的版本改写为 1tzt=x+1−ttϵ\frac{1}{t}\bm{z}_{t}=\bm{x}+\frac{1-t}{t}\bm{\epsilon}t1​zt​=x+t1−t​ϵ。因此我们设 σt=1−tt\sigma_{t}=\frac{1-t}{t}σt​=t1−t​，这是加到未缩放图像上的噪声，与 EDM 类似。由此，我们可以把 EDM [29] 定义的系数改写为：cskip=1tσdata2σdata2+σt2c_{\text{skip}}=\frac{1}{t}\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}}{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}cskip​=t1​σdata2​+σt2​σdata2​​ 与 cout=σdataσtσdata2+σt2c_{\text{out}}=\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}\sigma_{t}}{\sqrt{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}}cout​=σdata2​+σt2​​σdata​σt​​，其中 σdata\sigma_{\text{data}}σdata​ 是数据标准差，设为 0.5 [29]。我们选择 cin=tc_{\text{in}}=tcin​=t（=1σt+1=\frac{1}{\sigma_{t}+1}=σt​+11​），使得送入网络的直接输入（*即* cin⋅1tztc_{\text{in}}\cdot\frac{1}{t}z_{t}cin​⋅t1​zt​）仍然是 ztz_{t}zt​。可以证明，只有当 t→0t\rightarrow 0t→0 时，才有：σt→+∞\sigma_{t}{\rightarrow}+\inftyσt​→+∞、cskip→0c_{\text{skip}}{\rightarrow}0cskip​→0、cout→1c_{\text{out}}{\rightarrow}1cout​→1，此时它趋近 x\bm{x}x-预测。我们还考虑一个更简单的线性预条件器：cskip=tc_{\text{skip}}=tcskip​=t 与 cout=1−tc_{\text{out}}=1-tcout​=1−t，它也只在 t=0t=0t=0 时执行 x\bm{x}x-预测。

English original
As EDM [29] uses a variance-exploding schedule (that is, zt=x+σtϵ\bm{z}_{t}{=}\bm{x}{+}\sigma_{t}\bm{\epsilon}zt​=x+σt​ϵ ) and we use a (roughly) variance-preserving version (that is, zt=tx+(1−t)ϵ\bm{z}_{t}{=}t\bm{x}{+}(1{-}t)\bm{\epsilon}zt​=tx+(1−t)ϵ ), a fully equivalent conversion is impossible. To have a pre-conditioner in our case, we rewrite our version as 1tzt=x+1−ttϵ\frac{1}{t}\bm{z}_{t}=\bm{x}+\frac{1-t}{t}\bm{\epsilon}t1​zt​=x+t1−t​ϵ . As such, we set σt=1−tt\sigma_{t}=\frac{1-t}{t}σt​=t1−t​ , which is the noise added to unscaled images, similar to EDM’s. With this, we can rewrite the coefficients defined by EDM [29] as: cskip=1tσdata2σdata2+σt2c_{\text{skip}}=\frac{1}{t}\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}}{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}cskip​=t1​σdata2​+σt2​σdata2​​ and cout=σdataσtσdata2+σt2c_{\text{out}}=\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}\sigma_{t}}{\sqrt{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}}cout​=σdata2​+σt2​​σdata​σt​​ where σdata\sigma_{\text{data}}σdata​ is the data standard deviation set as 0.5 [29] . We choose cin=tc_{\text{in}}=tcin​=t ( =1σt+1=\frac{1}{\sigma_{t}+1}=σt​+11​ ), so that the direct input to the network ( *i.e* . , cin⋅1tztc_{\text{in}}\cdot\frac{1}{t}z_{t}cin​⋅t1​zt​ ) is still ztz_{t}zt​ . It can be shown that only when t→0t\rightarrow 0t→0 , we have: σt→+∞\sigma_{t}{\rightarrow}+\inftyσt​→+∞ , cskip→0c_{\text{skip}}{\rightarrow}0cskip​→0 , cout→1c_{\text{out}}{\rightarrow}1cout​→1 , which approaches x\bm{x}x -prediction. We also consider a simpler linear pre-conditioner: cskip=tc_{\text{skip}}=tcskip​=t and cout=1−tc_{\text{out}}=1-tcout​=1−t , which also performs x\bm{x}x -prediction only when t=0t=0t=0 .

预条件器的结果。

English original
Results of pre-conditioners.

表 10 显示，预条件化的各个版本都灾难性地失败，这表明在高维空间中偏离 x\bm{x}x-预测并不可取。有趣的是，这些预条件化版本远好于 表 2 (a) 中的 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ-/ v\bm{v}v-预测。我们推测，这是因为它们在 t→0t{\rightarrow}0t→0 时更接近 x\bm{x}x-预测，从而缓解了该问题。

English original
Tab. 10 shows that the pre-conditioned versions all fail catastrophically, suggesting that deviating from x\bm{x}x -prediction is not desired in high-dimensional spaces. Interestingly, the pre-conditioned versions are much better than ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ -/ v\bm{v}v -prediction in Tab. 2 (a). We hypothesize that this is because they are more similar to x\bm{x}x -prediction when t→0t{\rightarrow}0t→0 , which alleviates this issue.
本站讲解：预条件器实验能证明什么、不能证明什么
表 10 在 JiT-B/16、ImageNet 256 上把三种损失（x\bm{x}x/ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ/v\bm{v}v）各配上三种输出层写法，结果是只有 cskip=0,cout=1c_{\text{skip}}=0,c_{\text{out}}=1cskip​=0,cout​=1 这一列可用（8.62–10.45），EDM 式与线性预条件器分别退化到 28.94–72.05 与 39.50–67.56。这支持的是“在这套像素空间设定下，把输出层写成 zt\bm{z}_tzt​ 的残差会灾难性失败”。它并不构成“x\bm{x}x-预测在任何设定下都优于 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ/v\bm{v}v-预测”的定理：实验只覆盖一个模型规模、一个分辨率、一种调度。另外，预条件器版本仍好于纯 ϵ\bm{\epsilon}ϵ/v\bm{v}v-预测，作者给出的解释是它们在 t→0t\to0t→0 时更接近 x\bm{x}x-预测——这是推测，原文用词是 hypothesize。

B.3 探索：分类损失

English original
B.3 Exploration: Classification Loss

本文聚焦极简设计，我们有意不使用任何额外损失。但需要说明，基于潜空间的方法 [49] 通常依赖用对抗损失与感知损失训练的 tokenizer，因此它们的生成过程并非纯粹由扩散驱动。接下来，我们讨论在像素空间模型上的一个简单扩展：额外的分类损失。

English original
Our paper focuses on a minimalist design, and we intentionally do not use any extra loss. However, we note that latent-based methods [49] typically rely on tokenizers trained with adversarial and perceptual losses, and thus their generation process is not purely driven by diffusion. Next, we discuss a simple extension on our pixel-based models with an additional classification loss.

形式上，我们在某个特定 Transformer block 之后接一个分类头（JiT-B 中为第 4 个 block，JiT-L 中为第 8 个）。分类器由全局平均池化接一个线性层组成，并对 1000 类 ImageNet 分类任务施加交叉熵损失。该分类损失 Lcls\mathcal{L}_{\text{cls}}Lcls​ 以权重 λ\lambdaλ（*例如* 100100100）缩放后，加到基于 ℓ2\ell_{2}ℓ2​（即逐元素平方误差之和）的回归损失上。为防止标签泄漏，我们在分类头之前的所有层关闭类别条件。我们注意到，这一改动仍然很小，且不依赖任何预训练分类器，与感知损失 [76] 不同。如 表 11 所示，这一微小改动带来了不错的提升。这一探索表明，我们的简单方法还有与额外损失项结合的进一步潜力，我们将其留待未来工作。

English original
Formally, we attach a classifier head after a specific Transformer block (the 4th in JiT-B and the 8th in JiT-L). The classifier consists of global average pooling followed by a linear layer, and a cross-entropy loss is applied for the 1000-class ImageNet classification task. This classification loss Lcls\mathcal{L}_{\text{cls}}Lcls​ is scaled by a weight λ\lambdaλ ( *e.g* . , 100100100 ) and added to the ℓ2\ell_{2}ℓ2​ -based ( *i.e* . , element-wise sum of squared errors) regression loss. To prevent label leakage, we disable class conditioning for all layers before the classifier head. We note that this modification remains minimal and does not rely on any pre-trained classifier, unlike the perceptual loss [76] . This minor modification leads to a decent improvement, as shown in Tab. 11 . This exploration suggests further potential for combining our simple method with additional loss terms, which we leave for future work.
本站讲解：分类损失只是探索，不属于本文方法
这一小节在像素模型上加了一个分类头（JiT-B 第 4 个 block、JiT-L 第 8 个 block 之后），用 λ\lambdaλ（例如 100）加权的交叉熵损失与 ℓ2\ell_2ℓ2​ 回归损失相加，为防标签泄漏还关掉了分类头之前的类别条件。表 11 里 JiT-B/16 由 4.37 降到 4.14、JiT-L/16 由 2.79 降到 2.50。但原文紧接着明确写了：其他实验都不使用该损失。所以读表 2、表 4 等主结果时，不能把这个分类损失算进方法本身；它是一条“还能往上加东西”的线索，作者把它留给未来工作。

尽管有提升，在本文呈现的其他实验中，我们不使用该损失、也不使用任何额外损失。

English original
Despite the improvement, we do not use this or any additional loss in the other experiments presented in this paper.

B.4 跨分辨率生成

English original
B.4 Cross-resolution Generation

在一个分辨率上训练的模型，可以通过对生成图像简单下采样或上采样，应用于另一分辨率。我们称其为跨分辨率生成。在我们的设置中，在 256 分辨率训练的 JiT/16 与在 512 分辨率训练的 JiT/32 具有可比的参数量和计算量，使它们的跨分辨率比较有意义。结果见 表 12。

English original
A model trained at one resolution can be applied to another by simply downsampling or upsampling the generated images. We refer to this as cross-resolution generation. In our setup, JiT/16 at 256 and JiT/32 at 512 have comparable parameters and compute, making their cross-resolution comparison meaningful. The results are in Tab. 12

把 512 模型生成的图像下采样到 256 分辨率，得到 1.84 的 FID@256，表现不错。与 256 分辨率专家模型（FID@256 为 1.82）相比，这一结果仍有竞争力，同时保持相近的计算成本，并额外获得在 512 分辨率生成的能力。

English original
Downsampling the images generated by the 512 model to 256 resolution yields a decent FID@256 of 1.84. This result remains competitive when compared with the 256-resolution expert (FID@256 of 1.82), while maintaining a similar computational cost and gaining the additional ability to generate at 512 resolution.

另一方面，把 256 模型生成的图像上采样到 512 分辨率，得到明显更差的 FID@512：2.45，而 512 分辨率专家的 FID@512 为 1.78。这一退化源于上采样造成的高频细节丢失。

English original
On the other hand, upsampling the images generated by the 256 model to 512 resolution results in a noticeably worse FID@512 of 2.45, compared with the 512-resolution expert’s FID@512 of 1.78. This degradation is caused by the loss of higher-frequency details due to upsampling.
